# OpenApps by MBZA

OpenApps by MBZA is a Cloudflare-native App Store and Google Play intelligence platform.

- Web: https://apps.mbza.dev
- API: https://apps.mbza.dev/api/v1
- Docs: https://apps.mbza.dev/docs
- MCP: https://apps.mbza.dev/mcp
- Source: https://github.com/mbzadev/openapps

The MCP endpoint offers 29 tools: 25 read and four write. It uses OAuth 2.1 with `openapps:read` and `openapps:write` scopes. The runtime consists only of Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, R2, Queues and Durable Objects.
